mapper.insert: INSERT INTO woorido.posts ( id, challenge_id, created_by, content, is_notice, is_pinned, like_count, comment_count, view_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{challengeId}, #{createdBy}, #{content}, #{isNotice}, #{isPinned}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{viewCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.challenge_id as CHALLENGE_ID, p.created_by as CREATED_BY, p.content, p.is_notice as IS_NOTICE, p.is_pinned as IS_PINNED, p.like_count as LIKE_COUNT, p.comment_count as COMMENT_COUNT, p.view_count as VIEW_COUNT, p.created_at as CREATED_AT, p.updated_at as UPDATED_AT, u.nickname as AUTHOR_NICKNAME, u.profile_image_url as AUTHOR_PROFILE_IMAGE FROM woorido.posts p JOIN woorido.users u ON p.created_by = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT id as FILE_ID, image_url as FILE_URL, display_order FROM woorido.post_images WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY display_order ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.*, ROWNUM RNUM FROM ( SELECT p.id as ID, p.challenge_id as CHALLENGE_ID, p.created_by as CREATED_BY, p.content as CONTENT, p.is_notice as IS_NOTICE, p.is_pinned as IS_PINNED, p.like_count as LIKE_COUNT, p.comment_count as COMMENT_COUNT, p.view_count as VIEW_COUNT, p.created_at as CREATED_AT, u.nickname as AUTHOR_NICKNAME, u.profile_image_url as AUTHOR_PROFILE_IMAGE FROM woorido.posts p JOIN woorido.users u ON p.created_by = u.id
ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC, ${sortColumn} ${sortOrder} ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE RNUM > #{startRow}
